# Torvi's Bounty: the Downs

*The caravans that cross the Beacon Downs pay Torvi to keep the high road open, and Torvi shares the purse: defeat 60 duskhawks, downs howlers or millstone rams. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Torvi will pay it again, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Torvi Brask](../npcs/torvi_brask.md) |
| Level | 50 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 Downs monsters ([Duskhawk](../monsters/duskhawk.md), [Downs Howler](../monsters/downs_wolf.md), [Millstone Ram](../monsters/millstone_ram.md))

## Rewards

- 70,560 EXP
- 6,000 mesos
- +40 standing with [Torvi Brask](../npcs/torvi_brask.md)
- +30 standing with Urbanograd
